title: Calico dbt input catalog (v1)
description: Closed, manifest-anchor-only trust catalog for the dbt input boundary (D-02/D-16). Every entry pins only safe release identity plus two SHA-256 anchors -- the ordered-source revision fingerprint and the hash of the revision's own manifest.json -- so this document can be committed to a public repository without ever carrying a canonical object hash, byte size, schema, row count, or filesystem path. Those facts are trusted only from an anchor-matching revision manifest inside the owner-controlled store, verified at preflight time.
